message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python3 -c "
import struct
data = open('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame','rb').read()
header_len = struct.unpack('>i', data[11:15])[0]
frame_len = struct.unpack('>q', data[16:24])[0]
nbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[30:38])[0]
cbytes = struct.unpack('>q', data[39:47])[0]
typesize = struct.unpack('>i', data[48:52])[0]
chunksize = struct.unpack('>i', data[53:57])[0]
print(f'header_len={header_len} frame_len={frame_len} nbytes={nbytes} cbytes={cbytes} typesize={typesize} chunksize={chunksize}')
nchunks = nbytes // chunksize + (1 if nbytes % chunksize else 0)
print(f'nchunks={nchunks}')
print(f'offsets chunk at {header_len+cbytes}, size={frame_len-(header_len+cbytes)-30}')
print(f'data starts at {header_len}')
print(f'trailer at {frame_len-30}')
"
